item.text: The defect is visible in `sortNotes`: its pinned comparison is reversed, so unpinned notes sort first. I’m also checking the store’s persistence/hydration behavior because the requirement explicitly covers reload ordering and pin-only mutation semantics.

Persistence stores the ordered `notes` array directly, so sorting it correctly at mutation time preserves the order across reloads. I’m applying two state-only corrections: pinned-first comparison, and pin/unpin updates that preserve `updatedAt` so the operation changes no note field except `pinned`.
